fixes.explanation: Ha! Nobody sends elders across town for that when someone's about to die, friend. The text says he sent them "…to ask Him to come and heal his servant." (Luke 7:3). His servant is sick and about to die, so I think the centurion skips the small talk and asks for the one thing that matters.

Nice list, friend, but the elders never read it out. What they tell Jesus is that the centurion "…loves our nation and has built our synagogue." (Luke 7:5). Built it! I've stamped a whole lot of cookies in my day and never built so much as a shelf.

That's a résumé the elders never hand over, baker. They say the centurion "…loves our nation and has built our synagogue." (Luke 7:5). He built a whole synagogue. The biggest thing I've ever built is a cookie box, and I needed a lot of help with that.
